implementation.detail: the draw programs PA_CL_CLIP_CNTL ZCLIP_NEAR/FAR_DISABLE from the pipeline's snapshot, so the viewport depth range becomes the clamp interval, and pipeline creation refuses depthClampEnable unless the logical device enabled the feature; all eight applicable upstream leaves pass, the six draw.renderpass ones reading their result back through the DEPTH-aspect 64KB_Z_X readback

native.note: Measured on an owned PS5 in the 362/363 acceptance-shaped run of 2026-09-21 that promoted the four DXVK262-T05 features, with zero Fail among the promoted leaves, zero NotSupported, no missing, unexpected or duplicate results and no device loss.

cts.note: 22 original upstream leaves whose indirect commands carry firstInstance 1, 2 or 3 (single, multi-command and four-instance shapes, non-indexed and uint32-indexed with bind/allocation offsets) passed unchanged in the combined 211/211 strict run.

implementation.detail: a non-zero firstInstance in a resolved indirect command is delivered to the start-instance user SGPR when the feature is enabled and refused otherwise

native.note: Combined strict CTS run (211/211 Pass, exit 0, verified Close Game) plus the public-SDK indirect witness: indirect firstInstance 5 over three instances and indexed indirect firstInstance 200 over two instances landed in exactly their instance cells with the delivered gl_InstanceIndex encoded, no wrong or stray cell, strict_verified=1.

cts.note: All 98 applicable upstream blend.dual_source leaves are acceptance cases now and passed twice on hardware: once in the 404-case measurement run on the gated candidate and again in the canonical acceptance run 20260921T160602225Z_PPSA99994_upstream-cts_0x15bf4c85ab360 on the promoted shipping payload 0bbd6679da721eac7f750b7bbea5041bac974ac8f42a9a94ff5a755caff0b3a7 (log sha256 30a0a14af266cc4d65943644eaa2c9ca9afe349e4f8c7ebbb7cad22627f57922), which reports 404 Pass, zero Fail, zero NotSupported with strict artifact and lifecycle identity and a clean title closure. The leaves exercised every factor and operation pair the family generates.

implementation.detail: the fragment module's secondary export is packaged as the exact 0x44/0xff pair, the front end and the compiler refuse a SRC1 equation without the enabled feature and the proven export, the runtime serves the whole GFX1013 blend contract with partial colour write masks carried in the render-target block, and the deterministic native witness separates the primary export from the blended value; all 98 applicable upstream dual-source blend leaves passed in the 404-case hardware run

native.note: Deterministic public-path blend witness: control RGBA 64,128,191,255 inside one LSB of the primary export with blending disabled, candidate 51,51,38,255 exactly for color=SRC1_COLOR*ZERO+ADD and alpha=ONE*ZERO+ADD, the two required to differ, fence success, strict_verified=1 and a clean lifecycle. The separate public-ABI probe reports dualSrcBlend=1 on the promotion candidate.

cts.note: Original upstream leaves in the frozen acceptance selection, passing unchanged.

implementation.detail: POLYMODE_FRONT/BACK_PTYPE with DUAL_MODE and KEEP_TOGETHER_ENABLE program the LINE and POINT polygon modes, and any other mode, or these two without the enabled feature, are refused at pipeline creation; all twenty-eight rasterization culling leaves pass, sixteen of them the _line and _point variants. The twenty-ninth applicable leaf, the amber line_continuity one, is not runnable on this profile and not a defect in this feature: Amber demands host-coherent memory this device does not advertise

native.note: Measured on an owned PS5 in the 362/363 acceptance-shaped run of 2026-09-21 that promoted the four DXVK262-T05 features, with zero Fail among the promoted leaves, zero NotSupported, no missing, unexpected or duplicate results and no device loss.

cts.note: Both unchanged upstream fragment-side-effect kill leaves pass on the exact integrated shipping candidate together with the frozen 304-case regression selection: 306/306 Pass, zero Fail or NotSupported, strict artifact and QPA identity, and clean title closure.

implementation.detail: fragment-stage storage writes and atomics are compiled and delivered through the descriptor table; the deterministic native witness separates a zero-write control from exactly 4096 fragment writes with 30 guard words intact, and both unchanged upstream frag_side_effects kill oracles pass in the integrated 306-case hardware run

native.note: Deterministic public-path SSBO witness: control_counter=0, candidate_counter=4096, 30 trailing guard words intact, fence success, strict_verified=1 and clean lifecycle. The separate public-ABI probe reports fragmentStoresAndAtomics=1 on the promotion candidate.

cts.note: 35 original upstream leaves drawing through uint32 index buffers (indexed multi-command, firstInstance and instanced indirect shapes with bind and allocation offsets, and the uint32-indexed draw-parameter leaves) passed unchanged in the combined 211/211 strict run; upstream has no leaf that places an index above 2^24, so the range witness is the public-SDK one.

implementation.detail: uint32 index buffers are fetched by the VGT at 32 bits with 64-bit host range arithmetic and a 32-bit BaseVertex add, so the full index range is executable and maxDrawIndexedIndexValue reports 2^32-1

native.note: Combined strict CTS run plus the public-SDK indirect witness: indices 0x80000000..0x8000000b with vertexOffset INT32_MIN (direct and indexed indirect), 0x01000000..0x0100000b with vertexOffset -16777216 and a uint16 control each landed in cells 0..3 by gl_VertexIndex/3 with no wrong or stray cell, so the fetched 32-bit index and the signed BaseVertex add are exact at bit 31 and at the 2^24 boundary; strict_verified=1.

cts.note: The promoted geometry leaves run in the frozen selection and pass their own upstream oracles in the strict acceptance run 20260917T190009Z-class run of the advertised profile (286/286 Pass, zero Fail, title closed); the leaves whose shapes the merged pre-raster program does not deliver yet - the uniform/sampled descriptor variants and the varying crosses - were measured as Fail in the preceding promotion run and are kept as diagnostics instead of being claimed here.

implementation.detail: the merged vertex+geometry pre-raster program is compiled, packaged and run on the graphics path: the ES->GS input handoff it reads, the triangle, point and line input families under their own input assemblies, gl_InvocationID, gl_PrimitiveIDIn and the five mandatory minima are hardware-witnessed by the nineteen-case geometry witness (shipping-mode run 20260917T183522678Z, strict_verified, cases=19, gpu_readback, lifecycle_ok, including case 15 with expected=1024 covered=1024 and the points/lines cases at 218/218 and 467/467), and the profile reports the five geometry limits at the Vulkan floor this profile exercised in src/graphics_limits.h

native.note: The probe reports geometryShader=1; it executes capability queries, not geometry draws.

cts.note: All 1 original selected T07 leaves passed in both strict 829-case ordinary-build runs, run-3158572987094 and run-3231483363368, on exact eboot 95befcf38c164d38dec0748a9aa88608329fbc5e7681cc36ef70edff4f0f13f1; no Fail, NotSupported, missing or unexpected cases, with complete QPA and clean title closure.

implementation.detail: cube-array image/view negotiation and twelve-face GPU sampling are implemented, with unsupported tiled pitches refused at descriptor creation

native.note: Exact native tiled attachment-to-sample readback checked all twelve 256x256 cube-array faces and 12,288 pixels, including a nonzero view base; separate transfer-backed witnesses checked two cubes.

cts.note: Both leaves in the pinned tree that REQUIRE independentBlend pass. They are the attachment_write_mask attachment_count_2 pair of the render-pass module (vktRenderPassTests.cpp:6504), which draws into two colour attachments - R8G8B8A8_UINT and R8G8B8A8_UNORM - with their own write masks and reads each attachment back. The promoted candidate passed the frozen 464-case acceptance run 20260922T103049552Z_PPSA99994_upstream-cts_0x1983e4b36fa05 (payload 713150da, selection 91c37ed0), and the two dedicated_allocation siblings of the same factory stay diagnostics with a measured NotSupported: they need VK_KHR_dedicated_allocation, which this profile does not advertise.

implementation.detail: the render pass, the framebuffer, the pipeline key and the native per-target programming each carry one colour target per attachment with its own CB_COLORn block, its own blend control and its own CB_TARGET_MASK nibble, and the readback copies every attachment into its own buffer; the runtime compiler admits a two-target pipeline only when the device carries the capability, and the private two-MRT witness recorded one draw writing two attachments with different values before the upstream leaves were selected. Both attachment_write_mask attachment_count_2 suballocation leaves passed in the 464-case hardware run

native.note: Two colour targets in one pass with their own clear, their own CB_TARGET_MASK nibble and their own readback into separate buffers, and a fragment stage that exports both (start_index_0) or only the second target (start_index_1, which the driver programmes by renumbering the written attachment to hardware target zero - measured: the pinned compiler's export instruction carries no target). The private two-MRT witness (src/two_mrt_oracle.c, native/two_mrt_probe.c) and its oracle recorded one draw writing two attachments with different values before the upstream leaves were selected.

cts.note: 34 original upstream leaves issuing one vkCmdDraw*Indirect call with drawCount 2 or 3 (junk-strided and packed, non-indexed and indexed, single and four-instance, with and without firstInstance) passed unchanged in the combined 211/211 strict run; the four draw_index leaves judge DrawIndex 0..2 through the pinned DrawIndex shader.

implementation.detail: every command of a vkCmdDraw*Indirect call is resolved at the queue head and emitted in order with its own DrawIndex over a bounded arena chain; maxDrawIndirectCount is the core floor derived from the platform mask

native.note: Combined strict CTS run plus the public-SDK indirect witness: strided and packed multi-draw with a zero-primitive command keeping DrawIndex 1 and 2, GPU-generated arguments consumed behind a compute -> indirect barrier, and 65535 packed commands rendering 65535 distinct pixels (commands=65535 drawing=65535 draws=65535) over a 66-arena chain, every cell matched, strict_verified=1.

cts.note: Original upstream leaves in the frozen acceptance selection, passing unchanged.

implementation.detail: sixteen viewport and scissor banks are written per draw and selected by gl_ViewportIndex from a geometry stage, and a pipeline naming more than one viewport is refused unless the logical device enabled the feature; all twenty-two applicable upstream leaves pass, the six draw.renderpass.scissor ones clearing their target through the transfer destination and reading the rendered result back from the same image

native.note: Measured on an owned PS5 in the 362/363 acceptance-shaped run of 2026-09-21 that promoted the four DXVK262-T05 features, with zero Fail among the promoted leaves, zero NotSupported, no missing, unexpected or duplicate results and no device loss.

implementation.detail: precise occlusion counters complete on GPU and pass the original query oracle

native.note: Two strict native API runs checked zero, one and three depth-tested samples with direct/copied 32-bit and 64-bit results, availability, wait/partial, reset/reuse and completion.

cts.note: Representative reporting plus executable scalar R32_UINT OOB coverage; this is not every robustness permutation.

implementation.detail: raw storage/uniform descriptors carry the byte span and the vertex plan bounds the addressable vertex count against the bound data's extent

cts.note: The feature's own oracle - the leaves whose checkSupport requires DEVICE_CORE_FEATURE_SAMPLE_RATE_SHADING - at both served counts, for the triangle and quad shapes this profile renders. Three consecutive 514-case measurement runs reported all thirty Pass with zero quad failures, and the 494-case frozen acceptance selection that now carries them reported 494 Pass / 0 Fail / 0 NotSupported on the shipping profile.

implementation.detail: the raster stage programs MSAA_ENABLE, the sixteen PA_SC_AA_SAMPLE_LOCS_PIXEL_* words carrying Vulkan's standard 4x pattern and the sample distance that pattern asks for, and the pixel stage publishes SPI_BARYC_CNTL POS_FLOAT_LOCATION=2 whenever the wave iterates per sample, so fract(gl_FragCoord.xy) is the SAMPLE's position and every sample of a pixel receives a different one; the barrier that publishes a colour attachment to the texture path stores a completion token and waits for it, because the colour block writes back asynchronously and a read issued behind the bare event saw tiles it had not written yet

native.note: Native execution: the frozen 494-case acceptance run on the shipping profile reported every selected leaf Pass with a clean lifecycle, and the shipping witness payload (no measurement switch) reported one distinct sample id per sample and one distinct fract(gl_FragCoord.xy) per sample - the four standard 4x positions - each with a clean HELLO/BYE stream. The public-ABI probe run reports the feature true.

cts.note: All 64 selected clipping leaves passed in the 275/275 acceptance run (selection hash 3067f94c99fcfb5047e2ac4f7fa009caa898fbe55c62829ea10ccf6d71cb463d, eboot b58d88149e623adc5cd9d75dcb19d87bd4e6774c43f494093d0ea3c1d5bd3bc7, title closed). The family exercises clip counts 1..8 (the reported maxClipDistances floor), the combined clip+cull budget, the non-constant write and the fragment-stage read. The complementarity and misc leaves stay diagnostics: the pinned binary does not report them when filtered by the name the module's construction implies, measured twice, so they are not claimed here.

implementation.detail: the pre-raster stage exports its clip distances through the packed position registers and the fragment stage reads the interpolated value; both halves are implemented, bounded by the two registers (maxClipDistances, maxCullDistances and maxCombinedClipAndCullDistances are reported at the Vulkan floor of eight) and measured on hardware by the eleven-case clip/cull witness, whose pixel-read case verifies expected=4096 covered=4096 foreign=0 wrong_color=0 with digest f50dd9368fee6cc9

native.note: Eleven-case clip/cull witness: the packed export (static and dynamically indexed), the per-half-space cull rule and the fragment stage's read of the interpolated distance all verify on hardware - case 10 with expected=4096 covered=4096 foreign=0 wrong_color=0 and digest f50dd9368fee6cc9, the acceptance run strict_verified with the pixel-read digest differing from the control's.

cts.note: All 64 selected clipping leaves passed in the 275/275 acceptance run (selection hash 3067f94c99fcfb5047e2ac4f7fa009caa898fbe55c62829ea10ccf6d71cb463d, eboot b58d88149e623adc5cd9d75dcb19d87bd4e6774c43f494093d0ea3c1d5bd3bc7, title closed). The family exercises clip counts 1..8 (the reported maxClipDistances floor), the combined clip+cull budget, the non-constant write and the fragment-stage read. The complementarity and misc leaves stay diagnostics: the pinned binary does not report them when filtered by the name the module's construction implies, measured twice, so they are not claimed here.

implementation.detail: the same export and pixel-read path carries the cull distances, and the cull rule is per half-space rather than per vertex - the witness's cull cases prove a primitive is discarded only when a half-space is negative at every vertex, and the combined budget (maxCombinedClipAndCullDistances) is the same eight components

native.note: Eleven-case clip/cull witness: the packed export (static and dynamically indexed), the per-half-space cull rule and the fragment stage's read of the interpolated distance all verify on hardware - case 10 with expected=4096 covered=4096 foreign=0 wrong_color=0 and digest f50dd9368fee6cc9, the acceptance run strict_verified with the pixel-read digest differing from the control's.
